events.theme: “Beyond Awareness: Empowering Abilities, Advancing Inclusion, and Transforming Lives”
about: The Global Empowering Abilities: International Autism Summit 2027 is an international platform dedicated to advancing understanding, acceptance, inclusion, and empowerment of autistic individuals and the broader neurodivergent community. Under the theme “Beyond Awareness: Empowering Abilities, Advancing Inclusion, and Transforming Lives,” the summit brings together researchers, healthcare professionals, educators, therapists, psychologists, policymakers, advocates, families, technology innovators, organizations, and people with lived experience from around the world.

The summit aims to move beyond awareness toward meaningful action by exploring innovative approaches to autism identification, intervention, education, mental well-being, communication, assistive technology, employment, independent living, family support, and community inclusion. It will provide a collaborative environment for sharing research findings, practical experiences, emerging technologies, successful programs, and evidence-informed approaches that can help create more accessible and inclusive societies.

Through keynote presentations, expert sessions, research presentations, panel discussions, workshops, and networking opportunities, participants will have the opportunity to exchange knowledge, build international collaborations, and explore solutions that recognize and support the diverse abilities, strengths, needs, and aspirations of autistic individuals.

The Global Empowering Abilities: International Autism Summit 2027 seeks to inspire a global shift from simply raising awareness to creating opportunities, removing barriers, strengthening support systems, and empowering every individual to participate, contribute, and thrive.

events.title: International Forum on Emotional Intelligence & AI
events.theme: Bridging Human Intelligence & Artificial Intelligence: Advancing Emotional Awareness, Ethical Innovation & the Future of Human Connection.
description: The International Forum on Emotional Intelligence & AI is a global platform dedicated to exploring the evolving relationship between human emotional intelligence and artificial intelligence. The forum brings together researchers, psychologists, AI specialists, technology innovators, educators, business leaders, healthcare professionals, and policymakers to exchange knowledge, share research, and discuss how emotional intelligence and intelligent technologies can complement one another in an increasingly digital world.

As artificial intelligence continues to transform industries, workplaces, education, healthcare, and everyday communication, understanding the human dimensions of technology has become increasingly important. Emotional intelligence plays a vital role in empathy, communication, leadership, decision-making, and interpersonal relationships, while AI offers new opportunities to understand human behaviour, support emotional wellbeing, and enhance human capabilities.

Through inspiring keynote presentations, expert panel discussions, research presentations, and interactive sessions, the forum will explore AI-driven emotional recognition, affective computing, human-AI interaction, ethical AI development, emotional intelligence in leadership, mental wellbeing technologies, and the future of human-centered innovation.

The forum aims to encourage interdisciplinary collaboration, promote responsible AI practices, and explore how technology can be developed and applied in ways that respect human emotions, dignity, privacy, and individual differences.

Ultimately, the conference seeks to build a future where technological intelligence and human emotional understanding work together to create more empathetic, inclusive, ethical, and innovative societies.

description: The Quantum Summit on Trauma, Healing & Resilient Minds 2027 (Q.T.H.R.M.) is an international platform dedicated to advancing knowledge, research, and innovative approaches in trauma recovery, psychological healing, emotional wellbeing, and resilience development. The summit brings together psychologists, psychiatrists, neuroscientists, therapists, trauma specialists, healthcare professionals, researchers, educators, and mental health advocates from across the globe to exchange expertise, share research, and explore transformative approaches to supporting individuals affected by trauma and adversity.

Trauma and prolonged stress can have profound effects on emotional wellbeing, cognitive functioning, relationships, and overall quality of life. Understanding the psychological, neurological, social, and environmental dimensions of trauma is essential to developing compassionate, effective, and evidence-based approaches to recovery. The summit aims to highlight emerging research, innovative therapeutic practices, and holistic perspectives that support healing, strengthen coping mechanisms, and promote long-term psychological resilience.

Through inspiring keynote presentations, scientific discussions, expert panels, research presentations, and interactive sessions, participants will explore trauma-informed care, neuroscience of trauma, psychological therapies, emotional regulation, childhood adversity, PTSD, mindfulness-based interventions, neuroplasticity, and resilience-building strategies.

The summit seeks to foster interdisciplinary collaboration, encourage research-driven practices, strengthen trauma-informed approaches across healthcare and communities, and empower professionals with new perspectives and tools to support recovery and personal growth.

Ultimately, Q.T.H.R.M. aims to inspire a future where healing is accessible, resilience is strengthened, and individuals are empowered to move beyond adversity towards healthier, more fulfilling lives.

The forum aims to explore the interconnected relationship between human health, environmental sustainability, healthcare innovation, and social wellbeing while encouraging collaborative approaches to improving health outcomes worldwide.

faq.q: How to submit an abstract for the conference?
faq.a: To submit your abstract, please send an email to Contact@idias.org with the conference name and dates in the subject line. Make sure to follow the guidelines provided on the conference website and use the abstract template provided. Your abstract will be reviewed by our scientific committee to ensure that it is original and does not contain any plagiarism. Once your abstract is accepted, you will be notified via email. If you have any questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to contact us. Thank you for your interest in our conference.

faq.q: What will be provided in my speaker registration fees?
faq.a: Continuing Education (CE) Credits, an Attendance Certificate, ID Cards, Buffet Lunch, Coffee Breaks, Free Wi-Fi, Conference Proceedings, and a Scientific Program. Additionally, we will be providing a Hotel Shuttle Service from the airport to the hotel for the convenience of our attendees. We believe that these benefits will make your conference experience as enjoyable and productive as possible. Please feel free to contact us if you have any further questions or concerns. We look forward to welcoming you to the conference.

faq.q: Will I be funding myself or the conference is fully funded for the speakers?
faq.a: As a not-for-profit organization, we unfortunately do not have the resources to fully fund all of our speakers. However, we do offer some limited funding opportunities for select speakers, and we encourage all potential speakers. We also provide various benefits to our speakers, such as complimentary registration and discounts on accommodations, to help offset some of their expenses. We believe that our conferences provide an excellent platform for our speakers to showcase their work and connect with other professionals in their field. If you have any further questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to contact us.

faq.q: What is the name of the hotel that the conference will be held at?
faq.a: The hotel conference venues will be displayed on the venue category on the conference website respectively. For more information on the venue contact@idias.org.

faq.q: When is the deadline for the conference to register?
faq.a: We recommend that you visit the conference website or contact the organizers directly to confirm the registration deadline for the specific conference you are interested in attending. It is important to note that registration deadlines may be subject to change and may be affected by factors such as the availability of space or the number of registrants. Therefore, we encourage you to register as soon as possible to secure your spot at the conference and avoid any potential last-minute issues.
Spain, India, Paris, USA, Rome etc….. All conference for 2024 are updated at www.idias.org

The conference organizers will determine the time slot and schedule for each speaker based on various factors, such as the topic of the presentation, the length of the presentation, and the overall agenda for the event.

faq.q: What makes me qualified to speak at this?
faq.a: Ultimately, the conference organizers will have their own criteria and reasons for selecting you as a speaker, so it’s best to reach out to them directly for more information about why they believe you are qualified to speak at the event.

faq.q: How process the registration fee for the conference?
faq.a: To register for the conference, please visit the conference website and navigate to the “Register” tab. Select the appropriate category for your registration, and fill in all of the required fields in the registration form. Once you have completed the form, you can process your registration online using a credit or debit card, or PayPal. We also accept bank or wire transfers, and you can contact us at contact@idias.org if you would like to register using these payment methods. If you encounter any issues during the registration process, please do not hesitate to reach out to our customer service team for assistance. We are here to help and ensure that your registration process goes smoothly. Thank you for your interest in our conference, and we look forward to welcoming you soon.

faq.q: Can I ask how did you come across my profile and how did you decide to invite me to the event?
faq.a: I recommend contacting the conference organizers directly to inquire about how they identified you as a potential speaker and why they decided to invite you to speak at the event. They will be able to provide you with more specific information regarding their selection process and the criteria they used to choose you as a speaker.

faq.q: Can I just ask if I cancel my slot, will I be able to get a refund?
faq.a: We have a 100% refund policy. We want all to attend in physical meetings for better B2B networking and as such we have Virtual Meeting as a backup plan for physical meetings. Also, we are 100% refundable just case if the situation worsens. Please check our terms and conditions:- http://idias.org/termsconditions

privacy: i-DIAS
Privacy Policy for IDIAS

At Idias, accessible from idias.org, one of our main priorities is the privacy of our visitors. This Privacy Policy document contains types of information that is collected and recorded by Idias and how we use it.
If you have additional questions or require more information about our Privacy Policy, do not hesitate to contact us.

This Privacy Policy applies only to our online activities and is valid for visitors to our website with regards to the information that they shared and/or collect in Idias. This policy is not applicable to any information collected offline or via channels other than this website.
Consent
By using our website, you hereby consent to our Privacy Policy and agree to its terms.
Information we collect
The personal information that you are asked to provide, and the reasons why you are asked to provide it, will be made clear to you at the point we ask you to provide your personal information.

If you contact us directly, we may receive additional information about you such as your name, email address, phone number, the contents of the message and/or attachments you may send us, and any other information you may choose to provide.
When you register for an Account, we may ask for your contact information, including items such as name, company name, address, email address, and telephone number.
How we use your information
We use the information we collect in various ways, including to:
Provide, operate, and maintain our website
Improve, personalize, and expand our website
Understand and analyze how you use our website
Develop new products, services, features, and functionality

Communicate with you, either directly or through one of our partners, including for customer service, to provide you with updates and other information relating to the website, and for marketing and promotional purposes
Send you emails
Find and prevent fraud
Log Files

Idias follows a standard procedure of using log files. These files log visitors when they visit websites. All hosting companies do this and a part of hosting services' analytics. The information collected by log files include internet protocol (IP) addresses, browser type, Internet Service Provider (ISP), date and time stamp, referring/exit pages, and possibly the number of clicks. These are not linked to any information that is personally identifiable. The purpose of the information is for analyzing trends, administering the site, tracking users' movement on the website, and gathering demographic information.
Cookies and Web Beacons

Like any other website, Idias uses 'cookies'. These cookies are used to store information including visitors' preferences, and the pages on the website that the visitor accessed or visited. The information is used to optimize the users' experience by customizing our web page content based on visitors' browser type and/or other information.
Advertising Partners Privacy Policies
You may consult this list to find the Privacy Policy for each of the advertising partners of Idias.

Third-party ad servers or ad networks uses technologies like cookies, JavaScript, or Web Beacons that are used in their respective advertisements and links that appear on Idias, which are sent directly to users' browser. They automatically receive your IP address when this occurs. These technologies are used to measure the effectiveness of their advertising campaigns and/or to personalize the advertising content that you see on websites that you visit.
Note that Idias has no access to or control over these cookies that are used by third-party advertisers.
Third Party Privacy Policies

Idias's Privacy Policy does not apply to other advertisers or websites. Thus, we are advising you to consult the respective Privacy Policies of these third-party ad servers for more detailed information. It may include their practices and instructions about how to opt-out of certain options.

You can choose to disable cookies through your individual browser options. To know more detailed information about cookie management with specific web browsers, it can be found at the browsers' respective websites.
CCPA Privacy Rights (Do Not Sell My Personal Information)
Under the CCPA, among other rights, California consumers have the right to:
Request that a business that collects a consumer's personal data disclose the categories and specific pieces of personal data that a business has collected about consumers.
Request that a business delete any personal data about the consumer that a business has collected.
Request that a business that sells a consumer's personal data, not sell the consumer's personal data.
If you make a request, we have one month to respond to you. If you would like to exercise any of these rights, please contact us.
GDPR Data Protection Rights
We would like to make sure you are fully aware of all of your data protection rights. Every user is entitled to the following:
The right to access – You have the right to request copies of your personal data. We may charge you a small fee for this service.

The right to rectification – You have the right to request that we correct any information you believe is inaccurate. You also have the right to request that we complete the information you believe is incomplete.
The right to erasure – You have the right to request that we erase your personal data, under certain conditions.
The right to restrict processing – You have the right to request that we restrict the processing of your personal data, under certain conditions.
The right to object to processing – You have the right to object to our processing of your personal data, under certain conditions.
The right to data portability – You have the right to request that we transfer the data that we have collected to another organization, or directly to you, under certain conditions.
If you make a request, we have one month to respond to you. If you would like to exercise any of these rights, please contact us.
Children's Information
Another part of our priority is adding protection for children while using the internet. We encourage parents and guardians to observe, participate in, and/or monitor and guide their online activity.

Idias does not knowingly collect any Personal Identifiable Information from children under the age of 13. If you think that your child provided this kind of information on our website, we strongly encourage you to contact us immediately and we will do our best efforts to promptly remove such information from our records.
Thank you!
